raw.rationale: Refametinib is a potent allosteric MEK1/2 inhibitor, and PRISM single-agent screens show MEK inhibitors are broadly cytostatic with selective sensitivity concentrated in MAPK-pathway-driven lineages such as BRAF/RAS-mutant melanoma, colorectal, lung, and biliary/liver cancers; however, at a single 2.5 µM 5-day pooled viability readout, most lineages still fail the strict selective-kill criteria, so probabilities remain low with modest enrichment in skin, colorectal, lung, and liver.
